title: When silence is read as agreement
literal_meaning: Silence is a sign of agreement.
explanation: This maxim describes an inference people make from another person’s silence. Silence can also mean hesitation, fear or uncertainty, so it does not establish that someone has agreed.
meaning_odia: ଚୁପ୍ ରହିବାକୁ ସମ୍ମତିର ଚିହ୍ନ ବୋଲି ଧରାଯାଉଥିବା ଧାରଣାକୁ ଏହି କଥାଟି କହେ। କିନ୍ତୁ ଭୟ, ଦ୍ୱିଧା ବା ଅନିଶ୍ଚୟରେ ବି ମଣିଷ ଚୁପ୍ ରହିପାରେ; ସମ୍ମତି ନିଶ୍ଚିତ କରିବାକୁ ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ଉତ୍ତର ଦରକାର।
usage_example: A chair assumes the quiet room approves a plan; a participant asks for an explicit response from everyone. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The dictionary identifies a Sanskrit maxim. It is documented here as an expression to examine, not permission to treat silence as consent.
